<description>
Update time-machine to [8c2f8fe81bba0aed6c6b235325156960bdef834c](https://codeberg.org/guix/guix/commit/8c2f8fe81bba0aed6c6b235325156960bdef834c).

binutils `2.46` -> `2.47`.
cmake `3.31.10` -> `4.3.3`
linux-libre-headers-6.1 `6.1.172` -> `6.1.187`
python-lief `0.17.6` -> `1.0.0`

Default Clang/LLVM updated to `22.x` and `23.x` available.
GCC 16 now available.
</description>
